Webinar Panel: Journalism and AI:
Addressing Fears, Anxieties, and Concerns
Wednesday, October 28, 2026
10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET
Free to attend
In this webinar panel, three seasoned journalists —
Taylor Lorenz
,
Alexandra Marvar
, and
Brian Merchant
— will share how media workers can navigate AI tools and the various ways in which this technology has transformed the industry.
This panel will touch upon how legacy media outlets are coming up with AI rules, and what writers can do to protect their work. In addition, the panelists will discuss larger questions about how AI has changed the industry: Is it possible to integrate these tools in a workflow without plagiarizing other writers' work? Is there a double standard of media outlets banning freelancers from using these tools, while editors use in-house AI tools? What does it mean to have original prose in a time when LLMs can mimic style?
Register
here
.
STUDY HALL COURSES:
A Beginner’s Guide to Covering the Sex Industry
Sex work seems to be everywhere these days. Storylines about sex workers have popped up in shows like
Euphoria
,
Margo’s Got Money Troubles
, and
Hacks
. Yet even as OnlyFans has become a household name, few journalists actually understand the inner workings of this often underground industry — or how to build trust that’s needed to get sex worker sources to open up about these stories.
In this
course
, Lux Alptraum, an adult industry expert and one-time editor of the porn blog Fleshbot, will walk you through the basics of reporting on the sex industry. In addition to providing an overview of the different corners of the sex industry, she’ll also explain why so many sex workers do not trust journalists, and walk participants through the best practices for covering adult industry-related topics.
The 1.5 hour course will take place September 18th at 10 AM PDT/ 1 PM ET.
The standard price is $99. Study Hall members can use the discount code “studyhallmember” to bring the price to $49.50. For any questions, email
support@studyhall.xyz
.
Sign up
.
